fact_text: The petrol subsidy of PKR 100 per litre is paid to registered motorcycles, rickshaws and cars up to 800cc, so eligible owners must register to claim it.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Khaadi & Selmore IPO Plans Higher Gas Bills, LNG Supply Risks & Middle East Tensions | Shafy Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Household gas is priced in consumption slabs, so low-usage households pay a cheaper rate and heavy users pay more; this cross-subsidy design is what the government wants to replace.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Khaadi & Selmore IPO Plans Higher Gas Bills, LNG Supply Risks & Middle East Tensions | Shafy Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Industrial, commercial, CNG and captive power gas users pay rates above the average, and this premium helps fund the subsidised prices paid by household consumers.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Khaadi & Selmore IPO Plans Higher Gas Bills, LNG Supply Risks & Middle East Tensions | Shafy Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The government plans a single average gas tariff of about PKR 178 per MMBTU to replace consumption slabs, moving the subsidy from cross-subsidy to targeted direct cash support; it awaits IMF approval.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Khaadi & Selmore IPO Plans Higher Gas Bills, LNG Supply Risks & Middle East Tensions | Shafy Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A single gas tariff would raise bills for low-consumption households that now pay less, while lowering the rate paid by industrial users who currently pay above-average tariffs.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Khaadi & Selmore IPO Plans Higher Gas Bills, LNG Supply Risks & Middle East Tensions | Shafy Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Gas tariff reform needs IMF approval under the programme, so its timing depends on IMF sign-off rather than on the government alone.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Khaadi & Selmore IPO Plans Higher Gas Bills, LNG Supply Risks & Middle East Tensions | Shafy Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Cement makers are among the industrial gas users that pay above-average tariffs, so a move to a single average gas tariff would lower their gas cost.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Khaadi & Selmore IPO Plans Higher Gas Bills, LNG Supply Risks & Middle East Tensions | Shafy Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: For cement makers energy is a major production cost, so higher gas or power tariffs feed directly into the cost of each ton and pressure margins.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Khaadi & Selmore IPO Plans Higher Gas Bills, LNG Supply Risks & Middle East Tensions | Shafy Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Spot-market LNG costs far more than term-contract LNG, so when a term supplier cannot deliver, importers must buy replacement cargoes at a sharply higher price.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Khaadi & Selmore IPO Plans Higher Gas Bills, LNG Supply Risks & Middle East Tensions | Shafy Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Idle LNG import terminal capacity can be auctioned so that private firms import their own LNG, a way to use infrastructure that otherwise sits unused.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Khaadi & Selmore IPO Plans Higher Gas Bills, LNG Supply Risks & Middle East Tensions | Shafy Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A Strait of Hormuz disruption cuts oil and LNG shipments to import-dependent Pakistan, raising energy import costs, future financing costs and pressure on business profits.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Khaadi & Selmore IPO Plans Higher Gas Bills, LNG Supply Risks & Middle East Tensions | Shafy Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The government told the IMF that inflation could stay near 7.5% in FY2026 if Brent crude averages about USD 80 per barrel.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Khaadi & Selmore IPO Plans Higher Gas Bills, LNG Supply Risks & Middle East Tensions | Shafy Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: If Brent crude stays near USD 100 per barrel through December, the government's projected inflation rises to about 8.2%, matching its own FY2026 target.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Khaadi & Selmore IPO Plans Higher Gas Bills, LNG Supply Risks & Middle East Tensions | Shafy Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: PSO's net profit for FY2026 rose to about PKR 31.6 billion from PKR 14.2 billion a year earlier, roughly 2.2 times, according to the results discussed.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Khaadi & Selmore IPO Plans Higher Gas Bills, LNG Supply Risks & Middle East Tensions | Shafy Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: PSO's earnings per share for FY2026 were about PKR 52.49, against PKR 35.03 in the prior year.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Khaadi & Selmore IPO Plans Higher Gas Bills, LNG Supply Risks & Middle East Tensions | Shafy Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: PSO's receivables fell by about PKR 40 billion quarter on quarter in the reported period, which improves its cash recovery.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Khaadi & Selmore IPO Plans Higher Gas Bills, LNG Supply Risks & Middle East Tensions | Shafy Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: PSO announced a cash dividend of PKR 10 per share alongside its FY2026 results.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Khaadi & Selmore IPO Plans Higher Gas Bills, LNG Supply Risks & Middle East Tensions | Shafy Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: For oil marketing companies a falling receivable balance signals better cash recovery from government and customers, which can matter as much as reported profit.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Khaadi & Selmore IPO Plans Higher Gas Bills, LNG Supply Risks & Middle East Tensions | Shafy Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Selmore Pharmaceuticals is a veterinary pharmaceutical company.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Khaadi & Selmore IPO Plans Higher Gas Bills, LNG Supply Risks & Middle East Tensions | Shafy Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Before a public offering, some companies sell a block of shares to blue-chip investors in a pre-IPO placement, so the IPO has anchor demand from large institutions.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Khaadi & Selmore IPO Plans Higher Gas Bills, LNG Supply Risks & Middle East Tensions | Shafy Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The State Bank's remittance reward scheme pays about PKR 16 billion a year in cash prizes, funded by the banking industry rather than the government or SBP.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Khaadi & Selmore IPO Plans Higher Gas Bills, LNG Supply Risks & Middle East Tensions | Shafy Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Remittances must arrive through the banking channel and be received in every month of a quarter; each dollar received earns a digital entry, so steady monthly inflows earn more tickets.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Khaadi & Selmore IPO Plans Higher Gas Bills, LNG Supply Risks & Middle East Tensions | Shafy Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The remittance reward prizes are drawn quarterly, with a single top prize and many lower-tier winners; the first draw is set for January 15, 2027, on the October to December inflows.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Khaadi & Selmore IPO Plans Higher Gas Bills, LNG Supply Risks & Middle East Tensions | Shafy Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)
